target.scope: tenant_id + workspace_id with a bounded legacy/global policy

authority.service: re-reads the current User row; requires active and WORKSPACE_ADMIN+; binds status/is_active/role/raw tenant/raw workspace in a guarded no-op User UPDATE in the decision transaction
authority.target_scope: real foreign tenant 404; workspace-bound below ADMIN limited to same workspace or legacy workspace-less rows; ADMIN+ cross-workspace within tenant; unscoped/platform keeps global-legacy policy

routes.effect: guarded UPDATE of name/description/capabilities/promotion_episode_floor plus one AuditLog receipt
routes.transitions: empty or matching request -> no_change/effect=none; changed material -> verified; stale/competing -> 409; same-operation replay -> already_applied

routes.effect: guarded UPDATE status -> autonomous plus one AuditLog receipt
routes.transitions: non-autonomous -> autonomous; already autonomous new operation -> no_change/effect=none; same-operation replay -> already_applied; stale -> 409

durable_ledger.operation_identity: AuditLog.id is the server-owned operation id agent:<update|promote>:<supplied-or-generated>
durable_ledger.sensitive_material: no raw configuration, capability list, secret, SQL parameter or exception text in the receipt or logs
durable_ledger.readback: fresh session; audit fields and target state/material digest must match

result_states.no_change: empty/matching update or already-autonomous promote; 200 effect=none; no audit
result_states.effect_unknown: 503 effect=unknown; original identity; replay=do_not_repeat; no exception text

parallel_writers.AgentGovernanceService: registration/name/status writer; CAS detects concurrent changes to bound fields
parallel_writers.graduation/confidence: unrelated fields; promote binds prior status
